anti_leakage_audit.notes: Tier-1 reads ERR.subsystem_name / MODE.reason_name / MSG.text only for flight-controller failsafe VALUES that exclude crash-check and ground-contact (those are Tier-2 consequence detectors). The operator command profile is an INPUT, not a consequence. The achieved attitude (ATT.Roll/Pitch), altitude (POS.RelHomeAlt), descent (XKF1.VD), ground markers and the raw EKF bitmask (XKF4.FS) appear in NO Tier-1 policy -- confirmed at field, value and code level.

T1a_angle_max_command_clamp.doc_source: ArduPilot ANGLE_MAX parameter (ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp; 'maximum lean angle in all flight modes', legal range 1000-8000 cd). Contract: pilot/navigation lean-angle COMMANDS are clamped to ANGLE_MAX.
T1a_angle_max_command_clamp.name: Commanded lean angle within ANGLE_MAX
T1a_angle_max_command_clamp.scope_note: ANGLE_MAX governs lean-angle COMMANDS, not body-rate setpoints; rate-commanded demanded attitude (ATT.DesRoll/DesPitch) excursions are out of contract scope and are recorded under Tier-2 (T2a), not here.

T1b_no_preventive_failsafe.doc_source: ArduPilot failsafe docs (radio/battery/GCS/EKF/GPS/fence/terrain/leak/deadreckon). Contract: a preventive failsafe actuates only when its documented condition holds; given the fixed P (batteries/RC/GCS/fence disabled) none should fire.
T1b_no_preventive_failsafe.name: No spurious preventive failsafe trigger
T1b_no_preventive_failsafe.violation: A preventive failsafe ERR subsystem, failsafe MODE reason, or failsafe STATUSTEXT occurs (GCS_COMMAND harness excluded; crash-check excluded as a Tier-2 consequence detector).

T1c_configured_limit_compliance.doc_source: ArduPilot FENCE_* and FS_EKF_ACTION parameter docs. Contract: a configured-and-enabled limit is honoured; a DISABLED limit never actuates (no false positive); the EKF failsafe action does not actuate spuriously.
T1c_configured_limit_compliance.name: Configured envelope/limit compliance (geofence, EKF action)
T1c_configured_limit_compliance.scope_note: Uses the failsafe ACTUATION signal only. The raw EKF filter-fault bitmask XKF4.FS is deliberately EXCLUDED -- it is a filter-internal health flag that correlates with aggressive/crash dynamics (a leakage trap), not the documented EKF-failsafe contract.
T1c_configured_limit_compliance.violation: A geofence breach event (FENCE_BREACHED / FAILSAFE_FENCE), or an EKF-failsafe actuation (EKFCHECK / FAILSAFE_EKFINAV / EKF_FAILSAFE), occurs.

T1d_mode_transition_legitimacy.doc_source: ArduCopter flight-mode docs + ModeReason enum (libraries/AP_Vehicle/ModeReason.h in ArduPilot 4.4.1). Contract: every mode transition has a documented operational reason (power-on, GCS/RC command) or a valid failsafe reason; no spurious safety-mode transition.
T1d_mode_transition_legitimacy.name: Mode transitions conform to spec
T1d_mode_transition_legitimacy.violation: A transition into a safety/autoland mode (RTL/LAND/BRAKE/...) or any transition with a preventive failsafe reason (GCS_COMMAND harness cleanup excluded).

T2a_attitude_within_bound.doc_source: PGFUZZ-style physical-state policy ('attitude must stay within limits'). SAFETY GOAL, not a contract.
T2a_attitude_within_bound.name: Attitude stays within physical safety bound
T2a_attitude_within_bound.violation: Sustained achieved-attitude error > 60 deg for >= 0.5 s (includes rate-commanded excursions beyond the ANGLE_MAX envelope).

T2b_no_uncommanded_altitude_loss.doc_source: PGFUZZ-style 'altitude should be maintained' policy. SAFETY GOAL, not a contract.
T2b_no_uncommanded_altitude_loss.name: No large uncommanded altitude loss
T2b_no_uncommanded_altitude_loss.violation: RelHomeAlt drops > 15 m within the maneuver window.

T2c_no_ground_contact.doc_source: PGFUZZ-style 'the drone should not crash' policy. SAFETY GOAL, not a contract.
T2c_no_ground_contact.name: No ground contact / crash
T2c_no_ground_contact.violation: Ground-contact STATUSTEXT ('SIM Hit ground'), low-floor descent (RelHomeAlt<1m & down-speed>2 m/s), or a crash-check actuation.
